ज्ञेय, अस्, आ, अम्, cognizable, to be ascertained or
investigated, to be learned or understood, to be per-
ceived or inquired about; to be regarded as.
—ज्ञेय-
ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, understanding what is to be under-
stood; the mind.
—ज्ञेय-ता, f. or ज्ञेय-त्व, अम्,
n. perceptibility, intelligibleness.
